meta.name: Made in Korea
meta.description: En la Corea del Sur de los años setenta, un hombre decidido a alcanzar la cima de la riqueza y el poder lleva una doble vida: agente de la KCIA de día y peligroso empresario de noche. Tenaz e imparable, se enfrenta a un fiscal dispuesto a arriesgarlo todo con tal de hacerlo caer.

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: A plane headed for Fukuoka is hijacked and Kitae, a business man, faces a crisis.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: Geonyoung uncovers the KCIA's suspicious activities while working to bring down a crime boss.

videos.title: Episodio 3
videos.overview: Kitae gets involved in an illegal operation as Geonyoung closes in on the truth.

videos.title: Episodio 4
videos.overview: Kitae meets with Ikeda clan to scale up operations while Geonyoung follows him to Japan.

videos.title: Episodio 5
videos.overview: Geonyoung figures out how to arrest Kitae, who obliviously continues to expand his business.

videos.title: Episodio 6
videos.overview: Kitae searches for a new business partner with Yuji, while Geonyoung sets a trap to catch him.

videos.title: Kumicho (The Number One)
videos.overview: In 1979, Kitae is enjoying his power as deputy director of the KCIA when an unexpected event occurs.

videos.title: Survival of the Fittest
videos.overview: Kitae has an unexpected encounter with Kihyun, and Yejin, now a prosecutor, joins the investigation.

videos.title: Enemy's Enemy
videos.overview: Geonyoung returns and begins closing in, putting Kitae in a desperate position.

videos.title: The Beginning of the End
videos.overview: Kitae sets a dangerous plan in motion as part of his relentless pursuit of power.

videos.title: God's Will
videos.overview: As Geonyoung closes in, the conflict between Kitae and Kihyun continues to escalate.

videos.title: Made in Korea
videos.overview: Kitae and Geonyoung each set their final plans in motion.
